description: Recommend a first-shot process before any trial. Costs 1 call. Required: polymer.polymer_abbreviation (material grade, e.g. PP, PC, ABS), mold.product_ave_thickness (average wall thickness in mm), machine.injector.injector_screw_diameter_mm (screw diameter in mm). CRITICAL - ASK THE USER FOR SHOT MASS: always ask for the total shot weight (part(s) plus runner) in grams and pass it as the TOP-LEVEL field target_shot_weight_g (e.g. 62). Alternatively pass mold.product_total_weight, or mold.single_cavity_part_weight_g + mold.cavity_num + mold.runner_weight. WITHOUT shot mass, VPTL/MEL/IL are range MIDPOINTS (e.g. VPTL=45, MEL=115) instead of physically computed values - the result will NOT be realistic. machine_barrel_temperature_stage is a COUNT of zones (4 or 5), NOT a temperature. product_max_length is the melt flow length in mm (100-500), not wall thickness. Also pass business_id (your own job ID, no prefix) so the result is stored and a later optimize call needs only business_id + defect_info; the result returns process_no and process_index_id.

business_id.description: Your own business ID for this process (mould/part/job number), e.g. MOLD-A-100. The server adds a unique per-subscriber prefix automatically - do NOT add a prefix. Returned as process_no in the result; reuse it for later optimize calls.

product_ave_thickness.description: Average wall thickness, mm. Greater than 0 and less than 50.

product_total_weight.description: Total product weight in g (alternative to single_cavity x cavity_num).

single_cavity_part_weight_g.description: Single cavity part weight in g. With cavity_num and runner_weight this gives shot mass, enabling physical VPTL/stroke calculation instead of a range midpoint.

polymer_abbreviation.description: Material short name, for example PC or ABS.

target_shot_weight_g.description: Target shot weight in g, including runner. If provided, physical stroke/VPTL is computed from it. Strongly recommended for realistic first-shot positions.

name: first_shot
